results.title: The Days We Still Have
results.overview: The Days We Still Have is an emotional short film about determination, family, and hope amid the conflict affecting the UAE. As a student's education shifts online, his daily routine is disrupted by uncertainty, fear, and constant news updates. Miles away, his father, an overseas Filipino worker, continues working whenever it is safe, carrying the responsibility of providing for his family while facing the same fears. Meanwhile, a teacher struggles to keep her students motivated despite the circumstances surrounding them. As the student begins questioning the purpose of building a future he cannot be certain of, a heartfelt conversation with his father changes his perspective. He slowly realizes that determination is not about knowing what tomorrow holds, but finding the courage to keep going despite uncertainty.

results.title: Posthuman Lament
results.overview: A creature searches for its identity in a strange castle.

results.title: Dislocated Thumbs Part 1
results.overview: An experimental short film that follows the creator's headspace as he grapples with the loss of his memory, identity, and mind, which are twisted by overlapping influences.

results.title: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
results.overview: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

results.title: Buddy
results.overview: A heartwarming Filipino family dramedy about family, friendship, forgiveness, and the connections that bring people back together.

results.title: Blame It on the Movies
results.overview: During a therapy session, a tormented young man reconstructs his life story, which has been marked by abandonment. Just as he reaches his most intimate moment, a film director interrupts to halt the scene, blurring the lines between truth and fiction.

results.title: Growing Up... Sucks!
results.overview: He's sick of growing up and tries to rekindle his childness, but it just doesn't feel the same.

results.title: Ruckus
results.overview: A study session is interrupted by an irritating racket.

results.title: Reina de puerto
results.overview: Deep in the Valparaíso night, Panxita, an older trans woman crowned queen, meets Príncipe, a young man adrift in the port city. Amid stairways, dive bars, and alleyways, a fleeting connection forms, shaped by desire, care, and loneliness

results.title: Take Care Of Me
results.overview: A woman finally receives her immigration approval to join her husband abroad, but her dog’s severe respiratory condition makes it impossible for him to travel. Caught between leaving her loyal companion behind or giving up the life she has long awaited, she faces a painful and deeply human choice.

results.title: Misrouted
results.original_title: พัสดุไม่ระบุปลายทาง
results.overview: “Big” a young man from the fringes of Bangkok, begins working as a packer for an online general store. There, he meets “Kom” a senior colleague. Both feel they don’t quite fit into life in Bangkok, yet they find a sense of comfort in each other’s company. As their individual goals begin to diverge, Big is forced to reflect on his own path—whether to continue with his current life or to leave this place behind.

results.title: Children of Palestine
results.overview: The documentary reflects on the situation in Palestine from the perspective of a journalist, an activist, and a geopolitical analyst. It offers a deeply human perspective that seeks to raise public awareness. In a world where numbers are counted every day, the director attempts here to count the names. An important message of love for Palestine and for humanity, reminding us that «we are all children of Palestine»—meaning that each of us must consider ourselves part of the same human family.

results.title: The glimmer of tears
results.overview: Seven-year-old Abril is taken from his mother and placed in foster care in the hope of giving them both a better chance. There, he finds an unexpected companion in Luna, who helps him navigate the loneliness and heartache of their separation. But when he is finally reunited with his mother, happiness proves fleeting, and another loss awaits. Forced to confront separation once more, Abril embarks on a tender, heartbreaking journey that will shape his understanding of love, longing, and the things we carry long after someone is gone.

results.title: Gemma
results.overview: Gemma and Amber grow closer on a date, which throws Gemma into a surreal conflict across the different arenas of her body. Her Fear and Desire wage a battle that disrupts their fragile, budding connection.

results.title: Latir
results.overview: Chile, 2022. During the constitutional plebiscite in Chile, Manuel, a retired university professor, takes part in a body percussion workshop that profoundly transforms his life and helps him cope with his wife’s terminal illness.

results.title: Bloom
results.overview: During the first months of the pandemic, an old woman withers and blooms alongside her flower.

results.title: Finding Bernie
results.overview: When their mother criticizes their painted fingernails, a non-binary film professor confronts a lifelong struggle with gender identity. They set out on a journey—searching for a gender non-conforming childhood role model, traveling with a multigenerational trans community, and befriending a trans historian. Past and present intertwine, revealing how personal identity is shaped by collective memory—and how, for many trans people, the personal is inherently political.
